steps.message: The patch has been submitted. I have updated the documentation examples to prevent information leakage by logging detailed validation errors and request bodies on the server side and returning a generic "Validation Error" message to the client.

The documentation examples in `docs_src/custom_request_and_route/tutorial002*` and `docs_src/handling_errors/tutorial004.py` and `tutorial005.py` were updated to prevent information leakage. Previously, these examples returned the full request body and detailed validation errors to the client when a `RequestValidationError` occurred. The updated code now logs these details on the server side (using `print`) and returns a generic `"Validation Error"` message to the client.
